hierarchy-morphs.visual_critic_note: Intentional muted palette and clean card controls elevate this above generic, but the circle-pack layout overflows its container — the visualization is cropped at the bottom and sides, cutting off a third of the data.
hierarchy-morphs.encoding_integrity_note: Encoding is structurally honest — d3.pack() handles area math, force layout uses scaleSqrt, domains are data-driven via root.count(), and key functions are present on node/label joins — but bundle paths key by array index rather than a stable id, and the sunburst applies scaleSqrt to the radial axis (compressing depth bands) rather than the conventional linear scale where angle alone encodes proportion.
hierarchy-morphs.stress_test_note: handleHover iterates and mutates all 200+ nodes synchronously on every mouseenter/mouseleave without debouncing; a d3.timer fires full drawBundles (300 paths) on every animation frame during 600ms transitions; no touch event filtering or preventDefault to prevent ghost interactions on mobile.
hierarchy-morphs.cognitive_load_note: Single view at a time, 7-hue palette stays readable at 4–5 visible groups, labels gated by size threshold, and bundled connections rendered at 15% opacity keep the pack layout uncluttered — main unassessable risk is whether the 200-node simultaneous morph between 7 layout types causes tracking loss during animation.
